request.summary: Review why a no-argument Task Session cannot deterministically resume the nearest available SWU.
request.intent: Make repeated no-argument Task Session calls resume one uniquely nearest SWU, including after conversational context compaction.

execution.notes: The current contract has no durable zero-argument selector. Historical calls depend on conversational inference, while global telemetry recency cannot safely distinguish unrelated project work packs.

anti_pattern_hits: a no-argument invocation relies on conversational memory rather than a durable selector
global latest evidence could be mistaken for the current scoped continuation

workflow_gaps.summary: Task Session cannot deterministically recover the nearest current-session SWU after conversational context is compacted.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Step 1 requires an explicit target, historical no-argument invocations selected informally, and the repository contains many unrelated work packs.
